prompt: Create a Python 3.12 order management application. An order contains multiple products. A product can appear in multiple orders. Each order item contains a quantity and unit price. Provide CRUD operations and calculate the total order amount.

intentions.text: I can create a new order with one or more products, each with a specified quantity and unit price.
intentions.requires: a list of products with product ID, quantity, and unit price
intentions.observable: the order is created and listed in the order list; a confirmation message is displayed

intentions.text: I can retrieve a specific order by its unique identifier.
intentions.observable: the order details are displayed in the output

intentions.text: I can update the quantity or unit price of a product in an existing order.
intentions.requires: an order ID, a product ID, and new quantity and/or unit price
intentions.observable: the order item is updated and the new total is reflected

intentions.text: I can delete an existing order.
intentions.observable: the order is removed from the list and a confirmation message is shown

intentions.text: I can view a list of all orders.
intentions.observable: a list of all orders with their IDs and item details is displayed

intentions.text: I can calculate the total amount of an order based on the sum of (quantity × unit price) for each item.
intentions.requires: an order with product items containing quantity and unit price
intentions.observable: the total order amount is computed and displayed in the output
